messages:
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout for config v2025.03 -> 10% traffic to gateway pool A
deploy-bot: Post-deploy health checks scheduled: http://ci.internal/smoke/1748765432 (5m sampling)
oncall-bot: Alert: synthetic probe 'gateway-pulse' returned 3x p95 spikes in the last minute
marina: Saw the same in Grafana, p95 jumped from 60ms to 420ms. No 5xxs though.
alex: Can you paste the trace id? want to check if it's a KV warmup or tokenization blip
marina: trace=trc-3f9a, attached a short link: https://grafana/r/trc-3f9a
sean: Quick check — are we hitting a new model variant or quantized runtime on gateway A?
priya: This rollout only touched routing config + model pin for embeddings-route -> model:v2-quant. No kernel changes.
deploy-bot: Canary health summary (1m): success=98.7%, p50=34ms, p95=410ms, errors=0.12%
alex: 0.12% errors are all 429 rate-limit bursts from the local test load generator — not related. but p95 spike is concerning.
priya: I'm rolling a quick synthetic run against canary backends: `curl -sS -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null http://canary-gatewayA.internal/health`
priya: results: 0.03, 0.42, 0.04, 0.03, 0.39 (seconds) — pattern matches the spike.
sean: Could be intermittent GC on the warm instances. memory looks nominal though. Any host-level OOM/kernels logs?
marina: Checked node exporter: minor CPU bursts but no sustained GC. The traces show a single downstream KV call that had 350ms latency in the slow traces.
alex: If KV call latency is root cause, we should avoid rollback unless errors increase. Suggest pinning routing to keep traffic on stable pool B while we investigate.
priya: Agreed. Change window allows a quick routing pin for 30m. If stable, we continue the canary ramp. If not, full rollback.
deploy-bot: Executing action: pin-route embeddings-route -> poolB (stable) for 30m (initiated by priya)
marina: Pin applied. Canary traffic to pool A dropped to 0. Traffic now on pool B. Monitoring...
oncall-bot: Notice: post-action synthetic probe report: gateway-pulse p95 back to 48ms within 90s
sean: Nice. That strongly suggests an infra blip on pool A. We should add a follow-up: add a synthetic probe targeted at that KV shard and instrument the retry path.
alex: I'll open a short runbook item and add to the release notes: "Canary paused and routing pinned to stable pool B due to intermittent gateway-pulse p95 spikes tied to KV shard X; no customer-facing errors observed."
priya: Also added a canary note: keep canary at 0% until KV shard team finishes investigation.
marina: Can someone post the quick logs snippet for the slow trace? I'll attach to the issue.
alex: pasted logs: ```
[trc-3f9a] 2025-02-18T15:12:40Z GET /embed -> KV_GET shard:x latency=356ms
[trc-3f9a] route=embeddings-route backend=poolA instance=gw-a-12
```
sean: filing ticket now and tagging @kv-platform-team. Ticket 4521 created: https://tracker/internal/4521
priya: Decision: Hold full rollout, keep pin for 30m, monitor. If no regression in 30m, canary resumes to 25%. If p95 > 300ms or errors > 0.5% we rollback to v2025.02 (previous stable).
alex: Agreed. Also note in release notes and notify #customer-impact if we hit rollback threshold.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled quiet window for 30m lock will expire at 1748767210 unless extended.
marina: I'll stay on it for 30m then handoff to oncall if needed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary state set to PAUSED -> pinned to poolB. Logged action by priya.
